Updated 2026-10-23: the [runnable whitespace pilot](https://github.com/canblmz1/tautest/tree/8d8bb0308875493daace737c04c2988770230182/docs/evidence/adoption/vimsplain/pilot-2.1.5-2026-10-22) now uses published Tautest/core **2.1.5** on the same `e65d98c` source.

For a small optional first look, Node 22/24 is enough:

```sh
curl -fL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canblmz1/tautest/8d8bb0308875493daace737c04c2988770230182/docs/evidence/adoption/vimsplain/pilot-2.1.5-2026-10-22/observed/before.target.json -o vimgym-before.json
npx --yes tautest@2.1.5 analyze --from vimgym-before.json --runner vitest
```

Open `.tautest/review/report.md`: one recorded Survived target (`cmd.trim()` -> `cmd`), source and covering-test names. This reads the supplied report; it runs no project tests and evaluates no new quality gate. I reran this import with 2.1.5. On PowerShell use `curl.exe`.

The full pilot records 372 original tests passing, the new public-output assertion passing on original code and failing for that exact replacement, and two successful `verify` runs. Line 22 remains old baseline debt outside the recent diff, not a new PR finding.

Would you be willing to try the report-only step and reply here with the first result or setup error? Disclosure: I work on Tautest; the pilot runs above are ours.
